metadata.title: Download Nebula
metadata.description: Check the version before downloading. You need your own copy of Super Mario Galaxy.

page.paragraph_2: Check the version before downloading. You need your own copy of Super Mario Galaxy.

current.paragraph_1: The current public Windows release was published on 27 October 2026. v2 is coming soon and is not included in this download.
current.paragraph_2: Open the release page and choose Nebula-Setup.exe under Assets. Read that release’s requirements and installation notes; they can differ from the upcoming v2 guide.

v2.paragraph_1: The v2 installer, final requirements and upgrade notes will be added when the release is available. No v2 download date has been announced.

platforms.paragraph_1: The current release runs on 64-bit Windows 10 and 11.
platforms.paragraph_2: A native Vulkan version is in development. No public release date yet.
platforms.paragraph_3: Native support is being prepared. A public package has not been announced.
platforms.paragraph_4: An Android beta is released, with touch and controller support.
platforms.paragraph_5: An Apple silicon version is planned. No public release date yet.

before.paragraph_1: Nebula does not include game files. For v2, the supported copy is Super Mario Galaxy for Wii, North America (RMGE01), revision 0, as an ISO, RVZ or extracted folder.

footer.paragraph_1: A little closer to the stars.
footer.paragraph_2: © 2026 the Nebula developers. Nebula is free software under the GNU GPL v3. Super Mario Galaxy, Wii and Nintendo are trademarks of Nintendo. Nebula is not affiliated with Nintendo.
